headline: Committee to review $70,000 EMS funding, $43,500 police grant, an ALPR pilot program, and a 20-year solar energy agreement with 978 Solar Development LLC.
summary: The committee will take up new spending authorizations for the Fire and Police Departments, a pilot license plate recognition program, and a long-term solar energy billing agreement. It will also revisit a long list of previously tabled items dating back to 2015.
items: Authorize spending $300 gift from the Estate of Constance M. Cataldi for the Fire Dept.
Authorize spending $70,000 from Cataldo Ambulance Services for Fire Dept. EMS Coordinator salary.
Authorize spending $43,500 BJA FY25 Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance (JAG) Grant for Police Dept.
Introduce pilot program for Sound Thinking Plate Ranger Automated License Plate Recognition (ALPR).
Consider 20-year NET metering electricity offtake and billing credit agreements with 978 Solar Development LLC (New Leaf Energy).
Transfer $2,000 from Legal Services to Claims.
Review tabled item: Home Rule Petition for Credible Service for Six Lawrence Fire Fighters (383/26).
